purpose: Keep the Japan equity dashboard synchronized whenever an investment-related interaction materially changes the current view.

triggers.description: User posts a ticker, iSPEED chart, board, order screen, holding screen, or other market image.
User reports a buy, sell, execution, realized P/L, unrealized P/L, position size, average cost, or end-of-day result.
updates: performance-summary.json when official realized P/L changes

triggers.description: User asks buy/sell/hold, day-trade, swing, ranking, sector-flow, risk, event, or portfolio advice.
User asks for current status, re-check, latest ranking, or updated market view.
Morning strategy, intraday rerank, or after-close review is produced.

sourcePriority: iSPEED confirmed realized P/L / supplied screenshots
company IR / TDnet / JPX / official sources
derived calculations clearly marked as derived
safetyRules: Do not overwrite official realized P/L with derived execution-price P/L.
Do not invent missing prices, quantities, or order details.
Keep pre-market forecast separate from intraday rerank so forecast accuracy can be evaluated honestly.
Separate day-trade and swing judgments even for the same ticker.
A chat message is not an external webhook: synchronization occurs when ChatGPT handles the triggering investment interaction and has GitHub access.
